'''Gavril Marius Farkas''' (born 1973) is a Hungarian-Romanian-German mathematician specializing in [[algebraic geometry]]. He is known for his work on [[algebraic curve]]s, [[moduli space]]s, and [[syzygy (mathematics)|syzygies]] of [[algebraic variety|algebraic varieties]]. Farkas is a professor of mathematics at the [[Humboldt University of Berlin]].

==Education and career==
Farkas was born in [[Oradea]], Romania,<ref name="vita">{{cite web|url=https://www.math.hu-berlin.de/~farkas/lebenslauf/|title=Prof. Dr. Gavril Farkas, CV|website=www.math.hu-berlin.de|access-date=April 15, 2025}}</ref> and earned his Bachelor of Science degree in mathematics from [[Babeș-Bolyai University]] in [[Cluj-Napoca]], Romania, in 1995, specializing in geometry and topology. He obtained a Master of Science degree from the Mathematical Research Institute in the Netherlands in 1996 and completed his PhD at the [[University of Amsterdam]] in 2000<ref>{{cite web |title=First MATH+ Distinguished Fellow: Gavril Farkas (HU Berlin) |url=https://mathplus.de/news/mathplus-first-distinguished-fellow-gavril-farkas/ |publisher=MATH+ |access-date=14 April 2025}}</ref> with thesis ''The Birational Geometry of the Moduli Space of Curves'' written under the direction of {{ill|Gerard van der Geer|de}}.<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=51085}}</ref>

He has held academic positions at the [[University of Michigan]], [[Princeton University]], and the [[University of Texas at Austin]]<ref name=texas /> before becoming a full professor at Humboldt University in 2007.<ref>{{cite web |title=Prof. Dr. Gavril Farkas |url=https://www.mathematik.hu-berlin.de/~farkas/ |website=www.mathematik.hu-berlin.de}}</ref>

==Honors==
*2023 Elected member of [[Academia Europaea]]<ref>{{cite web |title=Farkas Gavril |url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Farkas_Gavril |website=Academy of Europe}}</ref>
*2022 Elected full member of the [[Berlin-Brandenburg Academy of Sciences and Humanities]]<ref>{{cite web |title=Neue Mitglieder der BBAW |url=https://www.bbaw.de/presse/pressemitteilungen/pressemitteilung-neue-mitglieder-der-bbaw |website=BBAW |language=en}}</ref>
*2019 [[European Research Council|ERC Advanced Grant]] SYZYGY<ref>{{cite web |title=Zwei Millionen Euro für HU-Mathematiker Gavril Farkas - News - WISTA Management GmbH |url=https://www.wista.de/aktuelles/news/zwei-millionen-euro-fuer-hu-mathematiker-gavril-farkas |website=WISTA |date=28 March 2019 |language=de}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Two Million Euros for HU Mathematician Gavril Farkas |url=https://www.hu-berlin.de/en/press-portal/nachrichten-en/march-2019/nr-19328 |publisher=Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin |language=en}}</ref>
*2014 Ad Astra Prize for Excellence in Scientific Research<ref>{{cite web |title=Premiile Ad Astra: Despre dimensiunile matematicii cu Gavril Farkas |url=https://adevarul.ro/blogurile-adevarul/premiile-ad-astra-despre-dimensiunile-matematicii-1574276.html |newspaper=[[Adevărul]] |access-date=14 April 2025 |language=ro |date=28 October 2014}}</ref>
*2005 [[Sloan Research Fellowship|Alfred P. Sloan Research Fellowship]]<ref name=texas>{{cite web |last1=Leahy |first1=Cory |title=University of Texas at Austin faculty receive Sloan Research Fellowships |url=https://news.utexas.edu/2005/05/18/university-of-texas-at-austin-faculty-receive-sloan-research-fellowships-3/ |publisher=UT Austin News - The University of Texas at Austin |date=18 May 2005}}</ref>
